text:
rachel: heads-up, eu-west canary is throwing 502s right after helm apply. deploy-bot posted an alert.
tom: saw it. Which overlays merged into this run?
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary healthcheck failed for gateway-service v6.0.0-canary (eu-west). Failures: 7/15 in 3m. Merged overlays: base,region-eu,feature-x,staging-rollout-notes.
emily: staging-rollout-notes? that's the one that injects a docs URL and toggles basePath for our staging UI. That would explain routing mismatch.
infra-oncall: two remediation paths: 1) rollback to 5.9.8 (quick) but it loses TLS header fix included in 6.0.0; 2) values-only hotpatch to remove the staging keys and promote 6.0.0-hotfix. Change window ~18m.
rachel: prefer hotpatch to keep TLS fix. I'll prepare a values patch that removes staging keys (basePath and docsUrl) and promote as values-only hotfix. Also request a pin for eu-west to avoid automatic roll-forward.
deploy-bot: Manual pin requested by @rachel: pin gateway-service chart to 5.9.8 in eu-west until validation completes. Automated rollback skipped.
tom: runbook snippet:
```bash
# apply values-only hotfix
helm upgrade --install gateway-service ./charts/gateway -f values.yaml -f hotfix-strip-staging.yaml --namespace prod-eu-west --set promoter=hotfix-bot
kubectl rollout status deploy/gateway-service -n prod-eu-west --timeout=120s
```
emily: after hotfix, run e2e (smoke + routing) for 20m, check latency and 5xx rate across zones.
build-bot: note: the CI merge pipeline annotated this PR with merged-overlays list. Suggest adding a merge gate to prevent overlays whose name contains "staging" from targeting prod branches. I'll create a PR template entry.
infra-oncall: also add an admission preflight in deploy-bot to reject overlay merges that add keys under ingress.basePath or docsUrl when target=prod. That would have blocked this.
rachel: hotfix applied -> 6.0.0-hotfix (values-only). Pods restarted, smoke checks return 200s. Rolling e2e now.
tom: thanks. Keep the canary pinned for 25m and watch for any cross-region side effects.
emily: opening a short postmortem and release note line: "fix(values): strip staging rollout notes overlay that altered routing; resolved 502s in eu-west canary". Will include links to the hotfix release and PR for deploy-bot rule.
build-bot: opened PR #6001 adding a pre-merge lint to warn on overlay names containing "staging" and a schema check for ingress.basePath keys in prod overlays.
infra-oncall: agreed. After validation, clear pin and promote. Also add a runbook step to require explicit merged-overlay list in every release PR description.
rachel: TL;DR: values-only hotfix applied, canary pinned, follow-ups: deploy-bot preflight rule + overlay-name lint + release-note entry. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Pin cleared by @infra-oncall after validation window. (automated)
